warnings: PNG contains TWO portrait BOQ sheets laid out side by side in one landscape scan, per spec §11. Rotate the PNG 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. The physical RIGHT half is the LOWER-numbered sheet and is written to _1.json; the physical LEFT half is _2.json.

EVERY PRICE COLUMN IS BLANK ON EVERY ROW OF THE WHOLE BOQ -- ราคาหน่วยละ, จำนวนเงิน (material and labour), and รวมค่าวัสดุและค่าแรงงาน. This is a แบบ ปร.4 QUANTITY schedule issued unpriced by กองมาตรฐานราคากลาง for the estimator to fill in. Nulls are transcribed, never invented.

The title block is identical on every sheet of the set: form แบบ ปร.4, drawing numbers S-62047 / AR-61142 / SN-62034 / EE-62062 / M-62028, สถานที่ก่อสร้าง ทั่วไป, unit บาท, with ประมาณการโดย and ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ left blank.

*** THE BREAKER COUNT RECONCILES WITH EE-02 EXACTLY, AND IT PROVES THE 'BY ME' READING WAS RIGHT. *** The BOQ prices 1 x 14-way board with a 50AT-2P 10kA main, 2 x 20AT-1P RCBO, 3 x 16AT-1P RCBO and 2 x 16AT-1P plain -- which is EE-02's F1 and F2 (plain, lighting), F3/F4/F5 (RCBO, sockets) and F6/F7 (20AT RCBO, water heaters). SEVEN breakers, exactly the seven ways EE-02 specifies. The five air-conditioning ways are NOT here because they are priced in the mechanical category, precisely as the 'BY ME' bracket says.

*** THE EARTH ROD COUNT IS 2, WHERE EE-01 AND EE-02 BOTH SHOW ONLY ONE. *** The specification (ø14.20 mm x 2.4 m copper bond, buried 0.30 m) matches both drawings word for word, but the quantity does not. Flagged; the BOQ is the quantity authority.

EXOTHERMIC WELDING appears here and NOWHERE in the electrical drawings -- the cad-weld connection between the earth conductor and the rod. A real item that a take-off from EE-01/EE-02 alone would miss.

*** THE CONDUIT QUANTITIES ARE THE HEADLINE FIGURES: 423 m of ø15 mm PVC and 22 m of ø32 mm HDPE. *** The HDPE matches EE-02's buried service run ('ประมาณ 20 เมตร') with 2 m to spare. The 423 m of PVC is the whole building's wiring, a number no drawing gives.
Both conduit sizes and materials match EE-01's wiring specification exactly -- ø15 PVC for all final circuits, HDPE PN6 ø32 for the incoming service.
